# Xpress Waste Removals UK

> Environment Agency licensed, fully insured UK waste removal and rubbish clearance company serving Coventry (CV), Leicester (LE), Birmingham (B), and the surrounding Midlands 7 days a week.

## Quick Summary (Direct Answer)
Xpress Waste Removals provides same-day and scheduled man-and-van rubbish removal across Coventry, Leicester, and Birmingham. As a faster, easier, and often cheaper alternative to skip hire, our two-person crews handle all heavy lifting, loading, and sweeping with no council skip permit required. Pricing is upfront and volume-based, with reuse and recycling prioritised before landfill.

## Core UK Waste Removal Services
- [House Clearance](https://www.xpresswasteremoval.co.uk/services/house-clearance): Full and partial house clearances, loft, garage, cellar, probate, and end-of-tenancy clearances.
- [Garden Waste Removal](https://www.xpresswasteremoval.co.uk/services/garden-waste-removal): Green waste, branches, soil, turf, rubble, old sheds, fencing, and decking removal.
- [Furniture & Appliance Removal](https://www.xpresswasteremoval.co.uk/services/furniture-appliance-removal): Single-item or full-room collection of sofas, beds, mattresses, wardrobes, fridges, freezers, cookers, washing machines, and WEEE electricals.
- [Moving Service](https://www.xpresswasteremoval.co.uk/services/moving-service): Local flat and house moves, single-item collection and delivery, and student moves.
- [Office & Commercial Clearance](https://www.xpresswasteremoval.co.uk/services/office-commercial-clearance): Office desks, IT equipment, retail, warehouse, landlord, and builders/refurbishment waste clearances with out-of-hours slots and Waste Transfer Notes.
- [Recycling & Responsible Disposal](https://www.xpresswasteremoval.co.uk/services/recycling-responsible-disposal): Reuse, charity donation, and licensed recycling of wood, metal, cardboard, electricals, and household waste.

## Why Customers Choose Us Over Skip Hire
1. No council skip permit or road-blocking skip needed.
2. Two-person crew does all the lifting, carrying, loading, and sweeping.
3. Pay only for the volume of rubbish removed (quarter van, half van, full van, or single item).
4. Environment Agency licensed UK waste carrier with full insurance and Waste Transfer Notes.
5. Same-day and next-day collections available 7 days a week.
